say:1:1121169001:0.text: Apologies, I've been searching for signs of the Hypogean and haven't been able to catch up with you all until now.
say:1:1121169001:0.source_cn: 抱歉，我四处搜寻恶魔的踪迹，不小心走得太远，到现在才跟...

say:2:1121169002:1.text: The knights of the Heroic Order said you came to Ivoryshade to investigate. Have you discovered anything?
say:2:1121169002:1.source_cn: 骑士团的人说你们来月影乡调查了，有发现吗？

say:3:1121169003:1.text: But... Talene, what do you mean? You came to Ivoryshade with us, and then we split up to find the Hypogean!
say:3:1121169003:1.source_cn: 塔、塔琳小姐，你在说什么呀？你不是和我们一起来了月影乡...

say:4:1121169004:1.text: Came with you...? No, <style="highlight">I only just arrived</style>.

say:5:1121169005:1.text: Huh?! Has Talene lost her memory again?!
say:5:1121169005:1.source_cn: 难、难道塔琳小姐又失忆了？！

say:6:1121169006:1.text: I remember very clearly that after arriving in Holistone, the knights of the Heroic Order said you'd long since left.
say:6:1121169006:1.source_cn: 我记得很清楚，到达圣石镇后，骑士团的人说你们早已出发，...

say:7:1121169007:1.text: I looked for you immediately but was told you were off investigating the surrounding areas.

choice_prompt:8:1121169007.text: I looked for you immediately but was told you were off investigating the surrounding areas.
choice_prompt:8:1121169007.source_cn: 来到这里后，我立刻找人询问你们的所在地，但你们似乎在四处调查探索……

say:9:1121169008:1.text: I have no memories of this... What's going on here?
say:9:1121169008:1.source_cn: 我没有那样的记忆。这是怎么回事……

say:10:1121169010:1.text: How could this be? What Talene says is the opposite of what we were told!
say:10:1121169010:1.source_cn: 怎么会这样，塔琳小姐说的话和之前完全对不上！

say:11:1121169011:1.text: I remember the past few hours very clearly... Are you all telling the truth? I arrived with you before, and flew away north?
say:11:1121169011:1.source_cn: 我没有再次失忆的感觉……你们说的是真的？我之前和你们到...

say:12:1121169012:1.text: Chippy swears by his sword! We went to see the Deer Spirit statue together, and on the way, you felt the Hypogean's aura. Then we all split up to investigate!
say:12:1121169012:1.source_cn: 千真万确！我们一起去看了鹿灵雕像，路上你还感受到了恶魔...

say:13:1121169013:1.text: What's going on here? Talene was slowly regaining her memory before, so how did it deteriorate all of a sudden?
say:13:1121169013:1.source_cn: 这到底是怎么回事？塔琳小姐之前明明在慢慢恢复记忆，怎么...

choice_prompt:14:1121169013.text: What's going on here? Talene was slowly regaining her memory before, so how did it deteriorate all of a sudden?
choice_prompt:14:1121169013.source_cn: 这到底是怎么回事？塔琳小姐之前明明在慢慢恢复记忆，怎么一下子又恶化了呢？

say:15:1121169014:1.text: Both the statues of Dura and the Deer Spirit were enchanted to become pairs, and the Hypogean seems to focus on divine beings...
say:15:1121169014:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神像和鹿灵雕像都被施法变成了两个，那个恶魔的目标...

say:16:1121169015:1.text: Is it possible there are <style="highlight">two Talenes</style>?! Can Hypogeans also duplicate and mimic Celestials?!

say:18:1121169017:1.text: If Talene was duplicated by the Hypogean, that means one version arrived with us in Holistone, and the other traveled to Ivoryshade just now. That's the only explanation!
say:18:1121169017:1.source_cn: 如果塔琳小姐也被恶魔造出了复制体，其中一个和我们到了月...

choice_prompt:19:1121169017.text: If Talene was duplicated by the Hypogean, that means one version arrived with us in Holistone, and the other traveled to Ivoryshade just now. That's the only explanation!
choice_prompt:19:1121169017.source_cn: 如果塔琳小姐也被恶魔造出了复制体，其中一个和我们到了月影乡，另外一个刚刚才从圣石镇赶到，就能解释刚才的情况了！

say:20:1121169018:1.text: The Talene who came with us to Ivoryshade just now not only despises evil but also shielded us from harm... And I don't believe the Talene we just encountered is fake!
say:20:1121169018:1.source_cn: 刚才和我们一起来月影乡的塔琳小姐，不但嫉恶如仇，也会把...

say:21:1121169019:1.text: Are you saying the Talene before us could be an imposter?!
say:21:1121169019:1.source_cn: 你的意思是，我们面前的这个塔琳小姐才是假的吗？

say:23:1121169021:1.text: ... So it's possible that I'm just a replica of the Hypogean?
say:23:1121169021:1.source_cn: ……所以，我有可能是恶魔所造的复制体，对吗？

say:24:1121169022:1.text: A product of a Hypogean should not exist in this world.
say:24:1121169022:1.source_cn: 恶魔的造物，不该存在于这个世上。

say:25:1121169023:1.text: Talene, we don't mean that you—
say:25:1121169023:1.source_cn: 塔琳小姐，我们不是那个意思……！

say:26:1121169024:1.text: It's alright. I know what to do.
say:26:1121169024:1.source_cn: 没关系，我知道该怎么做。

say:27:1121169025:1.text: We'll find the other "me" and put an end to this once and for all.
say:27:1121169025:1.source_cn: 去找到另一个“我”……然后修正错误吧。
